findings.finding: affected_dependencies is frozen on first graph visit and can omit an input found affected later in the transitive closure, depending on descriptor hash ordering.
findings.required: Compute complete affected closure before reporting all affected edges; test diamond graph and alternate traversal order.

findings.finding: Validation followed by independent rereads can use metrics/config/returns from different source generations; compare_runs also combines scan_run metrics with separately read measurement.
findings.required: Bind all actually used bytes to one validated manifest snapshot; use metrics and measurement from same snapshot; add source replacement negative.

findings.finding: margin_call is derived from initial-margin buying power; declared maintenance rate is only validated at construction. Initial shortfall can therefore be mislabeled as maintenance breach.
findings.required: Separate initial buying power from maintenance call, independently test cash250/long10@100/mark90/initial20%/maintenance10%; verify partial internal funding remediation.

findings.finding: Dropping blocks with missing domain observations can produce full-window confidence decisions from selectively observed favorable samples.
findings.required: Keep descriptive complete-case statistics but mark incomplete observation and avoid whole-window confidence claims; add unfavorable-observation removal negative.

findings.finding: Keeping host HOME without isolated --config permits Docker's user proxy configuration to inject proxy variables/credentials into new containers.
findings.required: Use isolated empty Docker client configuration, and demonstrate sentinel host proxy config does not enter container.

findings.finding: Blocking O_RDONLY open precedes fstat regular-file rejection; a FIFO can hang staging before containment starts.
findings.required: Use lstat/nonblocking safe open/fstat checks and actual FIFO negative test; handle symlink/directory replacement safely.

findings.finding: Checkpoint binds event journal only. A fresh account with different allocations/specs/owners/currency/FX/opening time can restore it without verifying the original account configuration.
findings.required: Bind complete canonical opening configuration hash, reject mismatches before applying any event, independently test changed capital and instrument specification.

findings.finding: Converting rounded base-currency PnL back into native currency could lose 1e-8 of collateral loss.
findings.resolution: Calculate the native unrealized loss from native position cost before FX reporting rounding.

findings.finding: Artifact upload excluded hidden .quant-studio directories; JUnit passed but downloadable original execution records were absent.
findings.required: Include controlled hidden fixture evidence, rerun Linux CI, independently download and verify actual run/isolation/environment outputs.
